import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='mixed')
acct = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
# baseline weekday avg excluding anomaly window
base = acct[(acct.date<='2025-10-12')]
piv = base.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
wkday = [d for d in piv.columns if d.weekday()<5]
sat = [d for d in piv.columns if d.weekday()==5]
sun = [d for d in piv.columns if d.weekday()==6]
piv['exp_wk']=piv[wkday].mean(axis=1); piv['exp_sat']=piv[sat].mean(axis=1); piv['exp_sun']=piv[sun].mean(axis=1)
for d in ['2025-10-13','2025-10-14']:
    day = acct[acct.date==d].groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].sum()
    exp = piv['exp_wk'] if pd.Timestamp(d).weekday()<5 else (piv['exp_sat'] if pd.Timestamp(d).weekday()==5 else piv['exp_sun'])
    diff = (day - exp.reindex(day.index, fill_value=0)).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print(d); print(diff.head(10)); print('total diff', diff.sum())

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

m = a.join(b, lsuffix='_13', rsuffix='_06', how='outer').fillna(0)
m['dcost'] = m.unblended_cost_13 - m.unblended_cost_06
print(m.sort_values('dcost', ascending=False).head(8))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='mixed')
acct = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
recent = acct[acct.date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-08')].pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='date', values='price', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)

for idx,row in recent.iterrows():
    bm = base_med.get(idx, 0)
    if bm==0: continue
    for d in [pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13'), pd.Timestamp('2025-10-14')]:
        v = row[d]
        if abs(v-bm)/bm > 0.5:
            print(idx, 'base price', bm, str(d.date()), v)
print('done')
